production_readiness_assessment.go_live_recommendation: DO NOT deploy to production without addressing P0_CRITICAL patches. Acceptable for personal use with monitoring and restart automation.
key_concerns: Gateway crashes on network issues (#2359, #2272, #2369) - UNACCEPTABLE for production
Multiple deadlocks and race conditions cause unpredictable failures (#1812, #2365, #1862)
Resource leaks require manual intervention (#2365 lock leaks, #1951 SIGUSR1 locks)
Message loss during restarts (#1862) - violates data integrity requirements
Poor error handling leads to cascading failures
No enterprise database support - SQLite limits scalability (#1568)
Docker requires interactive mode - blocks CI/CD automation (#1950)
Security issues: credential exposure (#2321, #2320), no rate limiting (#2149)
Cross-platform issues: Windows broken (#1963, #2172, #2256), ARM issues (#1889)
Enterprise integrations broken: Copilot Enterprise (#1797), Azure OpenAI (#2332)
Multiple provider integrations broken: Ollama (#2275), Venice AI (#2315)
Plugin system unreliable (#2173, #1831 process isolation needed)

C:local_first_gateway.claim: Clawdbot is built around a local-first Gateway that bridges messaging channels to model providers and tool execution
implications: Requires explicit network configuration for remote access
Enables offline operation for some tasks

C:secure_by_default_bind_localhost.claim: Default-safe posture: Gateway binds to localhost; remote access requires authenticated tunnel (e.g., Tailscale)
security_controls: Require auth token for any remote access

C:compaction_feature_exists.claim: Clawdbot implements compaction to manage sessions near model context limits
caveats: Has failure modes under extreme load (I_2254)

C:known_risks_tool_output_bloat.claim: Large tool outputs cause session storage bloat leading to compaction failures

C:known_risks_provider_crosstalk.claim: Provider crosstalk can leak data between sessions; requires cryptographic isolation

C:whatsapp_pairing_safety_risk.claim: WhatsApp pairing has caused unintended outbound messages; requires safety controls

C:gateway_crash_on_network_failures.claim: Gateway crashes on transient network failures making it unsuitable for production without fixes
C:gateway_crash_on_network_failures.impact: CRITICAL - Service unavailable during brief network issues

C:resource_leak_problems.claim: Resource leaks (session locks, file handles) accumulate over time requiring manual intervention
C:resource_leak_problems.impact: HIGH - System becomes unusable, requires restart

C:message_loss_risk.claim: Messages can be lost during gateway restarts due to race conditions
C:message_loss_risk.impact: CRITICAL - Violates data integrity requirements for production

C:enterprise_blockers_exist.claim: Multiple critical blockers prevent enterprise adoption

C:production_readiness_score.claim: Current production readiness score is 4/10 with 12 critical blockers
